depositor_declared_processing.source: GEO GSM records, !Sample_data_processing, read for all 12
depositor_declared_processing.reference_verbatim: The GRCh38 reference genome assembly was used, keeping only the primary chromosomes chr1 - chr22, chrX, chrY, chrM.
depositor_declared_processing.pipeline_verbatim: HiChIP paired-end sequencing data was processed using HiC-Pro version 2.11.0 with a minimum mapping quality of 10. FitHiChIP was used to identify 'peak-to-all' interactions using peaks called from the one-dimensional HiChIP data. A lower distance threshold of 20 kb and an upper distance threshold of 2 Mb were used. Bias correction was performed using coverage specific bias.
depositor_declared_processing.resolves_F6: hg38 is declared by the depositor for the contact layer, and the Cluster-24 peak set is hg38 from the same accession. Both sides of E are hg38 by declaration, not by inference. No liftover is required or performed.
depositor_declared_processing.constrains_F5: E inherits FitHiChIP's own 20 kb - 2 Mb distance window. F5 adds no filter of ours; the window is the depositor's and is recorded rather than re-imposed.
depositor_declared_processing.bias_column_explained: 'coverage specific bias' correction is why the significance column is Q-Value_Bias rather than a plain q-value. F1 thresholds that column, which is the one the depositors' own analysis used.

PEAK_TO_ALL__WHY_F3_DOES_REAL_WORK.finding: FitHiChIP was run in 'peak-to-all' mode using peaks called from the ONE-DIMENSIONAL HiChIP data. Only one anchor of any interaction is guaranteed to be an H3K27ac peak; the other is an arbitrary bin.
PEAK_TO_ALL__WHY_F3_DOES_REAL_WORK.why_it_matters: Those H3K27ac peaks are BULK - they come from the HiChIP library itself, not from microglia. So the contact layer carries no microglial information at all. Requiring BOTH anchors to overlap a Cluster-24 accessible element (F3 primary) is therefore not a redundant tightening of something the contact data already guarantees; it is the ONLY step that makes E microglial.
PEAK_TO_ALL__WHY_F3_DOES_REAL_WORK.matches_the_work_order: This is exactly the nuance the V60 work order set out: 'because HiChIP contacts are bulk and the microglial information comes from the accessibility mask, the synthetic positive should not assume microglia-specific contact strength... a genuine regulatory edge has externally supported 3D contact + accessibility in the relevant cell state.' The data structure turns out to match that framing precisely, which is a point in favour of the design rather than a coincidence to be glossed.
PEAK_TO_ALL__WHY_F3_DOES_REAL_WORK.consequence_for_the_sensitivity_arm: The '>=1 anchor accessible' arm is therefore substantially weaker than it looks: an edge could qualify with its bulk H3K27ac anchor inaccessible in microglia. That arm must be reported but must not be promoted to primary.

DONOR_KEY_REMAINS_UNPROVEN.question: Is the HiChIP donor key A_B (00_38) as proven for scATAC in Data Set 2, or A (00)?
DONOR_KEY_REMAINS_UNPROVEN.searched: All 12 GEO GSM records, fields Sample_title, Sample_source_name, Sample_characteristics, Sample_description, Sample_treatment_protocol.
DONOR_KEY_REMAINS_UNPROVEN.result: NO DONOR IDENTIFIER IS EXPOSED. Titles are region plus an index - 'HiChIP Control Middle Frontal Gyrus 1', 'HiChIP Control Caudate 2'. Characteristics carry only 'tissue: brain' and 'brain region: <region>'. The string 'donor' appears only in boilerplate treatment-protocol text with no per-sample value.
DONOR_KEY_REMAINS_UNPROVEN.structure_confirmed: 6 regions x 2 samples = 12. Regions: MDFG, SUNI, CAUD, HIPP, PARL, SMTG. All 12 are labelled Control.
DONOR_KEY_REMAINS_UNPROVEN.classification: UNRESOLVED_AT_THE_GEO_LAYER. The filename-derived key stands as LIKELY_SAME_KEY__UNPROVEN, exactly as the freeze document declared it.

effect_of_the_two_readings.note: F2 requires >=2 distinct donors. Under the A key several samples merge, so FEWER edges would clear F2 - the A_B reading is the more permissive one. The per-edge donor support vector is retained in the object file precisely so F2 can be recomputed under the A key without re-reading 3.73 GB.

DONOR_KEY_REMAINS_UNPROVEN.next_rung_on_the_ladder: The paper's Supplementary Data Set 1 is the likely location of bulk/HiChIP sample QC metadata with donor identifiers. It has not been obtained. Until it is, no donor-level claim about the contact layer may be treated as load-bearing.
DONOR_KEY_REMAINS_UNPROVEN.explicitly_not_inferred: No donor-level overlap between the HiChIP layer and SEA-AD, Morabito, GSE214979 or GSE272082 is asserted or denied here. The University of Washington source-institution dependency recorded in V60 is unchanged and still carried.

self_audit.positive_control_on_the_method: The same GEO metadata route previously identified GSE160523 as a mouse study rather than confirming whatever it was given, so it demonstrably distinguishes wrong records.
self_audit.strongest_criticism: I confirmed hg38 from the depositors' own declaration rather than by independently verifying coordinates against a reference. The Cluster-24 peak file's maximum chr1 end (248,925,486) is consistent with hg38 but would also fit hg19, so that check alone is not decisive; the declaration is what carries it. A coordinate-level build verification remains undone.
self_audit.what_remains_unknown: The HiChIP donor key; whether Supplementary Data Set 1 exists in a form that resolves it; donor-level overlap with any of our cohorts.
